triage.detail: Only Then 2 (quote lists B1 x2 and B2 x1) is red, line 53; Thens 1, 3, 4, 5 green. R-15 (requirements-register.md:27): "Checkout quote reads the owner's cart (empty or over-stock is rejected) and a successful order clears the cart" - it asks for the quote to read the cart, not for an items array in the quote body. The documented contract (MyBooks/src/lib/openapi/spec.ts:934 Quote schema) lists only shippingMethod, promoCode, subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total; the person's gate A ruling Q1:a makes the documented contract the expected behaviour.

control.action: sign in as the seed user, empty the cart, POST /api/checkout/quote (empty), POST /api/cart bookId x2, GET /api/cart, POST /api/checkout/quote
control.without: the CART-1 change: the quote route is untouched by the story (last change commit b80a598, pre-existing; R-15 register status unchanged)
control.observed: Then 2 of TC_009 (one Then of five) expects the quote body to list the cart items. The quote of a filled cart answers 200 and prices the cart (subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total), the empty cart is rejected 400, but the body has no items array - the same with no change from this story. R-15 and the documented Quote schema do not ask for items in the quote body, so the assert asks more than the requirement; the person decides.
